note: Starter vocabulary of metric identifiers. Each identifier names a Metric Definition record (geof-metric-definition.schema.json) that fixes statUnit, numerator, denominator, eligibility, dedup and aggregation; the definitions here are summaries. Nothing in this file assigns a preferred direction to any value. Third parties extend under geof:x/<publisher>/<metric>/vN.

exposure.describes: whether the Object entered candidate sets and reached recipients

geof:exposure/retrieval-inclusion-rate/v.numerator: runs whose retrieved set contained the Object

geof:exposure/answer-inclusion-rate/v1.numerator: answers in which the Object appears in any representation kind other than OMITTED and RETRIEVED_NOT_USED

geof:exposure/invocation-incidence/v1.numerator: answers with at least one INVOKED entry for the Object

geof:exposure/invocation-intensity/v1.note: 10 answers, 1 with 3 calls -> 0.3 calls per answer

geof:exposure/targeted-reach/v1.numerator: intended recipients who received at least one representation

presentation.describes: how the engine presented the Object

geof:presentation/mention-rate/v1.numerator: answers with kind in {MENTIONED, CITED, RECOMMENDED, INVOKED}

geof:presentation/citation-rate/v1.numerator: answers with kind CITED (attribution with a resolvable reference)

geof:presentation/citation-share/v1.note: different denominator from citation-rate; both valid, not comparable

geof:presentation/first-citation-share/v.numerator: answers where the Object is the first citation

geof:presentation/position-adjusted-shar.note: share of answer text attributed to the Object weighted by position decay; decay constant fixed in the scoring Method

geof:presentation/share-of-voice/v1.denominator: representations of all Objects in the Frame's object set

geof:presentation/cross-engine-breadth/v.note: engines in the Frame in which the Object appeared at least once

geof:reception/positive-feedback-rate/v1.numerator: answers containing the Object with positive feedback
geof:reception/positive-feedback-rate/v1.denominator: answers containing the Object with any feedback signal available

geof:reception/no-feedback-rate/v1.numerator: answers containing the Object with no feedback signal

geof:reception/reuse-rate/v1.numerator: recipients with more than one INVOKED or ACTED followup

geof:reception/dispute-rate/v1.numerator: answers containing the Object that were disputed

fidelity.describes: truth relations, each relative to a declared reference set

geof:fidelity/occurrence-verified/v1.note: did the recorded run happen as recorded; reference = independent record of the run

geof:fidelity/relay-fidelity/v1.numerator: answers whose statements about the Object are supported by the Object's own source
geof:fidelity/relay-fidelity/v1.denominator: answers making statements about the Object

geof:fidelity/claim-coverage/v1.numerator: answers in which the named proposition is present

geof:fidelity/claim-support/v1.note: supported / contradicted / unverifiable counts of the source's own propositions against an external reference set

geof:fidelity/attribution-accuracy/v1.numerator: citations whose cited document supports the attributed statement

geof:fidelity/consensus-degree/v1.note: agreement across independent sources; ten reprints of one wire story are one source

geof:fidelity/omission-rate/v1.numerator: answers omitting a proposition the Method deems material

geof:fidelity/staleness-lag/v1.note: age of the source version the representation reflects

seo.describes: classic search measurements, kept in the source platform's units; condition-type metrics are states of the carrier

access.describes: conditions of access and governance; descriptive, not a consent or licensing mechanism

geof:access/crawl-permission-state/v1.note: robots directives and AI-preference signals as published

geof:access/licensing-terms-state/v1.note: machine-readable licensing terms as published (free, attribution, subscription, pay-per-crawl, pay-per-inference, none)

geof:access/crawler-auth-state/v1.note: share of crawls carrying verified crawler identity

geof:dynamics/run-to-run-volatility/v1.note: share of repeated runs of one Frame cell whose representation kind for the Object differs

economics.describes: ledger facts; no pricing or settlement rules

geof:economics/allocated-amount/v1.note: amount allocated to this dissemination by a declared rule; the rule is the Method

geof:economics/estimated-incremental-val.note: requires an attribution Method; distinct from actual revenue

attainment.describes: how far a declared Intent's expected change occurred; intentRef required

geof:attainment/attainment-rate/v1.numerator: intended recipients for whom the named expectedChange is recorded
geof:attainment/attainment-rate/v1.note: one statement per expectedChange; coverage states how many recipients have records at all

attribution.describes: how much of an outcome is due to this dissemination; intentRef required; always separate from attainment

geof:attribution/incremental-contributio.note: attributionBasis = counterfactual | experimental | model | declared; 'declared' is a claim, not an estimate

geof:attribution/intervention-effect/v1.note: change in a named metric after a recorded intervention, by a declared attribution Method
